title: Decision
description: Something a person has to decide, with the paths open to them (ADR-0041). The one shape every 'this needs you' takes — an intake question, a scope conflict the architect found, a gap nobody specified — so the dashboard renders all of them as the same actionable card rather than as prose to be read and answered by typing.

id.description: Stable within its source: an intake question id, or an id the proposer chose for this decision.

title.description: The decision, as one question a person can answer.

why.description: Why it needs deciding now, in one or two sentences: what goes wrong if nobody does.

source_ref.description: The document or node it is about, when there is one.

kind.description: What sort of decision — for an intake question, its hole kind (ambiguity, contradiction, …).

options.description: The paths open, each with what choosing it means. At most one is recommended.

label.description: The choice, short enough for a button.

consequence.description: What follows from choosing it — the specification that results, what it rules out.

allow_other.description: Whether a person may answer in their own words instead. Defaults to true.

allow_defer.description: Whether it may be left open on purpose. Defaults to true.
